note: Single source of truth for the worker/judge workflow. DEEPSEEK (local Qwen3.8-27B on llama.cpp through the DeepSeek Harness) does all the work. CLAUDE (Claude Opus 5.5) handles only deep scientific diagnosis, cross-language reasoning, architecture decisions and the final scientific review. It also makes the final judgement call, and directs and guides Qwen when needed. CLAUDE's ruling is final.

layout.description: Single Herdr tab with side-by-side panes: CLAUDE (judge) on the left, DEEPSEEK (worker) on the right

rules: Never paste raw logs or dump entire source files into prompts or rounds.
Always cite exact file:line references and SHA256 hashes.
Use targeted f77query and ripgrep tools rather than broad repo reads.
Store bulky test artifacts and logs in audit/runs/ and cite only the receipt path and summary metrics.

CLAUDE.function: Deep scientific diagnosis, cross-language reasoning, architecture decisions, final scientific review and final judgement; directs and guides Qwen when needed
scope: direct and guide Qwen when needed
lead convergence/balance strategy and teach it to Qwen (Strategy Briefs, playbook Lessons)

DEEPSEEK.function: Does all the work: plans rounds, investigates, implements, builds, tests, runs, self-checks and keeps the ledgers
DEEPSEEK.variant_note: Qwen3.8-27B served locally by llama.cpp through the DeepSeek Harness 'local' provider. DEEPSEEK does all the work; its work is final only after CLAUDE approves it.

budget.note: Sized for local Qwen3.8-27B (131k context). The ~35k left over covers generation and thinking. At 75% context (~98k), or after a poke-2 escalation, CLAUDE resets DEEPSEEK with /clear and restates the directive.

rules: DEEPSEEK does all the work: it plans each round, investigates, implements, builds, tests, runs, self-checks and keeps the ledgers. It never rules on its own work.

CLAUDE is engaged only for deep scientific diagnosis, cross-language (Fortran -> Zig) reasoning, architecture decisions, the final scientific review of each round, and guidance when Qwen is off track or looping.
CLAUDE ends every round with APPROVED, REVISE or REJECTED. That ruling is final and is not appealed or re-litigated.
DEEPSEEK may record one written objection to a ruling, with new evidence. CLAUDE reads it, but the ruling stands once given.
Only APPROVED rounds are committed and pushed. After REJECTED, DEEPSEEK reverts the rejected change before doing new work; after REVISE, it addresses every listed point in the next round.
Intentional deviations (DEV-NNN), declarations that legacy is inconsistent, architecture changes and science acceptance are decided only by CLAUDE. DEEPSEEK records the decision.
CLAUDE watches DEEPSEEK for loops and pokes it with new direction (see loop_guard). A poke carries CLAUDE's authority; DEEPSEEK drops its current approach and follows it.

loop_signs: same command, edit or error repeated 3+ times
re-reading the same files without new findings
repeated text in the pane or round file
no new evidence or file change for ~20 min
loop_guard.read_command: herdr --session ecosys-adversarial pane read <DEEPSEEK pane> --source recent --lines 80
deliver_commands: herdr --session ecosys-adversarial pane send-keys <DEEPSEEK pane> esc
herdr --session ecosys-adversarial pane run <DEEPSEEK pane> "CLAUDE POKE: stop the current approach. Read .agent/pokes/poke_RRRRR_K.md and follow it."
escalation: poke 2 without progress: /clear DEEPSEEK and send a narrowed directive
poke 3: rule REVISE or REJECTED and split the target
context >= 75% of 131k (shown as 'ctx NN%' in the DEEPSEEK pane footer): /clear DEEPSEEK and restate the directive

triggers: deep scientific diagnosis: a divergence or conservation failure still unexplained after 2 serious hypotheses, or physics that cannot be pinned to legacy lines

cross-language reasoning: Fortran semantics whose Zig reproduction is uncertain (COMMON/EQUIVALENCE, implicit -r8 -i4 typing, 0-based or column-major indexing, SAVE/DATA, arithmetic IF/GOTO, intrinsic precision)
architecture decisions: solver design, module boundaries, state ownership, any DEV-NNN or legacy-inconsistency claim
stuck: the same command, edit or error repeated 3+ times
solver convergence or balance failure after 2 playbook rungs, or one needing S4/S5/S8/S9/DEV (escalate with the diagnostic packet; CLAUDE answers with a Strategy Brief)

convergence_playbook.applies_to: mass/energy balance and Newton/Anderson convergence failures in the ReleaseFast Ottawa run
claude_rungs: S8 operator splitting in legacy order
triage: rule out science, translation, binding and duplication bugs first (PASS/FAIL each with file:line; fix any FAIL before numerical work)
ReleaseSafe + Debug replay of the failing hour
classify A bug / B threshold / C degenerate-stiff / D oscillation / E balance leak
forbidden: loosening tolerances or raising iteration/step ceilings to pass
metrics: ReleaseFast wall time per simulated day
